parsed.explanation: The state itself engineers outing: passport markers forced to birth sex (X eliminated), visa case-note flagging of trans applicants, and documented passport confiscation stranding travelers — universal border exposure. Foreign governments issued advisories. Facility bans affect 22+ states/provinces (some criminalized, one arrest documented); 4 states flagged Do Not Travel. Custody shows severe state harm: conversion-therapy-style prison policies, immigration abuse. Official rhetoric includes counterterrorism framing of 'radically pro-transgender' ideology; majority public opinion backs document restrictions. Mitigating: no trans criminalization, national employment and hate-crime protections, functioning courts enjoining several orders, active civil society, no sodomy law. Litigation is contested but real. The combination of state-engineered discovery, universal facility exposure in much of the country, and documented custody harm places this firmly in High Risk.
